---
name: factory-describe-pr
description: Draft a self-contained merge request / pull request title and description (what, why, how tested, risks, and a "how to review" guide for the human reviewer) for this branch with the factory-kit pr-describer agent, and save it for create-pr. Use before opening an MR or PR, or to fill in an empty one.
argument-hint: "[--base <branch>] [ticket link or extra context]"
---

<!-- Generated by sync-kit from factory-kit 0.14.0. Edit plugins/factory-kit in solo-factory, not this copy. -->

Draft the MR/PR description for the current branch. Arguments: `$ARGUMENTS`

1. Resolve the base: `--base` argument, else the MR target in `CLAUDE.md`, else `origin`'s default
   branch. Check `git log --oneline origin/<base>..HEAD` isn't empty; if there are no commits yet,
   say so and suggest `/factory-commit` first.
2. Collect what the agent can't see: the verify report, if `/factory-verify` saved one at the
   path `node ".claude/factory-kit/scripts/report-path.mjs" verify` prints (areas marked `not verified` must stay
   marked that way in "How tested"); test and check results from earlier in this session (exact
   commands and pass/fail), the ticket link or context from the arguments, and UI changes that
   need screenshots.
3. Launch the `factory-pr-describer` agent with the Agent tool. Give it:
   - the base ref and everything from step 2;
   - the spec path (`docs/specs/<N>.md`) when the branch belongs to an issue, and the plan path
     (`docs/specs/<N>-plan.md`) with the differences from the plan that `build` noted;
   - the repo (`gh api repos/{owner}/{repo} --jq .full_name`) and the commit for evidence links
     (`git rev-parse HEAD`, after the `docs(evidence)` commit);
   - the follow-up issue numbers from `ship`.

   Tell it plainly which checks were *not* run.
4. Read the draft against the diff once. Remove any claim the diff or the session doesn't support.
   Check that:
   - it ends with "How to review", and its line ranges exist;
   - when there is a plan, it has a "Differs from the plan" section, and each `Not run` line
     names what stopped the check;
   - it contains no `<!-- screenshot` placeholder (a repo CI check may fail on one);
   - every follow-up has an issue number;
   - the title is at most 100 characters, and 72 or fewer where it can be. Count them with
     `node -e 'console.log([...process.argv[1]].length)' "$title"`, not `wc`, which counts bytes
     in some locales. Shorten it here, before saving; `create-pr` must not have to cut it.
5. Save it to the path printed by `node ".claude/factory-kit/scripts/report-path.mjs" pr` (run it
   in the repo; don't build the path yourself): the title on the first line, a blank line, then
   the body. It sits outside the working tree, because `create-pr` requires a clean one, and
   outside `.git/`, because Claude Code blocks writes there. `create-pr` reads it from that path.
6. Show the title and body to the user and say where it was saved.
